extraction.notes: Three-month Q4 2022 column used. Items shown as an em dash ("—") for Q4 2022 (gain on sale of non-depreciable real estate assets; loss on debt extinguishment) entered as 0. The 'Gain on sale of non-depreciable real estate assets' line was categorized as 'other' since it is non-depreciable. COVID-19 related costs categorized as 'other'. Mark-to-market debt adjustment (13) is a debt fair-value item in interest expense; categorized as debt_cost_amortization as the closest fit. The reported 'Core AFFO' subtracts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. FFO, Core FFO, and Core AFFO totals reconcile arithmetically, and per-share figures reproduce with 118,646 thousand units (2.12, 2.32, 2.20). FAD (198,857) is below Core AFFO and was not included in the AFFO section.
